statement: Acceptance obligations: Dirty state leaving the live disc is parked and written by the next save instead of being discarded. / Dirtiness is defined per record, not only by voxel edits: modified water depths, fluxes, sleep and scheduling state, page bytes, entity records and ledger entries each carry their own dirty flag. / The host autosaves on a tick interval short enough to cover a traversal capture, and parked memory is bounded by a byte limit: when parking would exceed it the host performs a blocking save first, and while a save is failing eviction of dirty chunks stops (they stay resident) and the failure is reported; / dirty state is never dropped. / Parked bytes, save latency and failures are shown in the diagnostic panel and qualified on the historical 5,433-chunk edited save. / The ledger and deterministic scheduler foundation is implemented and enabled by default;
